The deployment rule is in sterling: Bitcoin fell 5.01% in dollars but 4.58% in sterling on 20 Nov, short of its 4.6% trigger, so under the rule it was not triggered.
decision_table_note.effect: None on any action or weight: Bitcoin has no written thesis, so it could not be added to either way.
